evidence_snippets: Medium GKE clusters on Description Severity Updated: 2021-12-22 The command for GKE in the following section should use gcloud beta instead of the gcloud command. gcloud beta container clusters update –no-enable-service-externalips Updated: 2021-12-15 For GKE, the following mitigation is now available: Starting in GKE version 1.21, services with ExternalIPs are blocked by a DenyServiceExternalIPs admission controller that is enabled by default for new clusters.
